# eslint-plugin-maintainability

Guide for AI coding assistants using this plugin in a project. To change the plugin's own source, read https://github.com/ofri-peretz/eslint/blob/main/AGENTS.md instead.

> ESLint maintainability rules — limits cognitive complexity, nesting depth, parameter counts, duplicate functions, and unhandled or silent errors.

## Enable it

```bash
npm install --save-dev eslint-plugin-maintainability
```

Requires ESLint ^8.40.0 || ^9.0.0 || ^10.0.0 and Node >=22.13.0.

Flat config files (`eslint.config.*`) are found by ESLint 8.57 and newer; on ESLint 9 and 10 they are the default.

```js
// eslint.config.mjs
import maintainability from 'eslint-plugin-maintainability';

export default [maintainability.configs.recommended];
```

Each preset is one flat config object: put it in the array as an element, do not spread it. Rule ids are prefixed `maintainability/`. Add it to the config you already have; do not remove other plugins. TypeScript files need a TypeScript parser in the config (`typescript-eslint`).

## Presets

| Preset        | Rules | Errors | Warnings |
| ------------- | ----- | ------ | -------- |
| `recommended` | 3     | 0      | 3        |

### `recommended`

3 rules:

- `cognitive-complexity` (warn): Enforces a maximum cognitive complexity threshold with refactoring guidance.
- `identical-functions` (warn): Detects duplicate function implementations with DRY refactoring suggestions.
- `max-parameters` (warn): Detects functions with too many parameters.

### Rules in no preset

Enable these by name (`'maintainability/<rule>': 'error'`); README.md describes each: `nested-complexity-hotspots`, `no-lonely-if`, `no-nested-ternary`, `consistent-function-scoping`, `no-unreadable-iife`, `error-message`, `no-missing-error-context`, `no-silent-errors`, `no-unhandled-promise`.
